findings.problem: The hint "show or hand in" uses the usual English meanings of mostrar and entregar, so a learner could reasonably give one of those instead of presentar.
findings.fix: hint: a project, report or document

back.es: to present, to submit (a project, report, evidence); also to introduce
back.example: Tomorrow I'm presenting my project in class.

note: The new hint still has to separate this card from the "to introduce" card, and "a project, report or document" does that.
